verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant. It answers based on your notes and proposes creates and updates for you to approve (capacities-docs-42). AI chats can take specific blocks or notes as context (capacities-docs-23), and selected blocks can be summarized or rewritten (capacities-docs-55). Data controls are fully opt-in: no space data goes to third-party AI unless you activate it (capacities-docs-16), and you can choose which context to pass. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of answer grounding and quality; documentation of finer-grained controls (per-space or per-object exclusion, model/provider and retention details) beyond the global opt-in.
